methods_quotes.q: The proportions of deaths among cases were calculated for the statewide general population, ALF residents, ALF staff members
cumulative counts were approximated by using maximum active numbers from outbreaks among available reports, or by combining numbers from active and inactive outbreaks
Proportion of deaths among COVID-19 cases was calculated by dividing deaths by cases.
When ranges were used instead of actual numbers, the minimum non-zero number within the range was used
Each state-level measure was summed to the national level and summarized across reporting states using median and IQR.
